name: raccoon-swarm
demonstrates: After entering .gameplay, RaccoonSpawnDirector spawns raccoons off-screen (>= ~1,056 points away, per farAxisMinimumTiles) following a 3s initial spawn delay, and RaccoonSeekBehavior walks them in toward the player at ~121 pts/s with a walk-animation while approaching. This journey waits long enough (~30s) for at least one raccoon to have closed the off-screen gap and be visible converging on the player, then waits further (~20s more) for a raccoon to reach the bite standoff ring and trigger BiteComponent's attack animation. HUD/HP/RABIES-row/infection-counter display is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this story (deferred to CYBERPUN-17-12) -- its absence in these screenshots is not a miss for CYBERPUN-17-8. Gate is human/vision review of the two gameplay screenshots below; assert_running steps only confirm the app process is still alive. The underlying spawn/seek/attack behavior is already pinned by RaccoonSwarmSceneWiringTests, RaccoonSpawnDirectorTests and RaccoonSeekBehaviorTests -- this journey exists purely so the runtime probe captures a frame late enough for a raccoon to actually be on screen, instead of one taken before any raccoon could possibly have arrived.

steps.target: the large neon-outlined PLAY button in the middle of the title screen that starts a new run (NOT the plain HIGH SCORES button below it)
steps.expect: the running game -- a playable isometric city scene with a ground lattice, buildings and a player actor, not a menu or title screen
